hook: There is a penguin with a real army rank.
facts: His name is Sir Nils Olav and he lives in a zoo in Scotland.
The King's Guard of Norway made him their mascot, then knighted him in two thousand and eight.
Every few years the soldiers come back, line up, and give him a higher rank.

hook: An octopus has three hearts and blue blood.
facts: Two hearts push blood to the gills. The third one pushes it to the rest of the body.
That third heart stops beating every time the octopus swims, so swimming makes it tired.
This is why an octopus would rather walk on the sea floor than swim.

hook: On Venus, one day lasts longer than one year.
facts: Venus turns around itself so slowly that one turn takes two hundred and forty-three Earth days.
But it goes all the way around the Sun in only two hundred and twenty-five Earth days.
So on Venus your birthday can come back before the day is even over.

hook: The Eiffel Tower is taller in summer.
facts: The tower is made of iron, and iron gets bigger when it gets hot.
On a hot day it grows by about fifteen centimeters, and nobody has to touch it.
It also leans a little away from the Sun during the day, then comes back at night.

hook: Cleopatra lived closer to us than to the pyramids.
facts: The Great Pyramid was already about two thousand five hundred years old when she was born.
The first Moon landing happened about two thousand years after her.
So she lived closer in time to a rocket than to the men who built the pyramids.

hook: The biggest desert on Earth is made of ice.
facts: A desert is not about sand. It is about how little water falls from the sky.
Almost no rain or snow falls on Antarctica, and some of its valleys have been dry for thousands of years.
It is bigger than the Sahara, so the coldest place on Earth is also the driest.

hook: The Pringles inventor is buried in a Pringles can.
facts: Fredric Baur invented the tube in the nineteen sixties so the chips would stop breaking.
He was so proud of it that he asked his family for a strange favor.
When he died, part of his ashes were placed in a Pringles can and buried.

hook: Oxford University is older than the Aztec Empire.
facts: Students were already learning at Oxford around the year one thousand and ninety-six.
The Aztec Empire only started in fourteen twenty-eight, more than three hundred years later.
So when the Aztecs were building their capital city, Oxford was already an old school.

hook: Some turtles breathe through their bottom.
facts: In winter the pond freezes over and the turtle stays under the cold water.
It takes in oxygen through a soft opening at the back of its body.
It works so well that some turtles stay down there for months without coming up for air.

hook: Chess has more games than the universe has atoms.
facts: After only four moves each, players can already reach almost three hundred billion different positions.
The number of possible full games is far bigger than the number of atoms we can see in space.
That is why nobody, not even a computer, has ever played out every chess game.
